title: MV-IVF: Multi-Vector Retrieval via Multi-Vector Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2611.09040v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-vector retrieval represents each query and document as a set of embeddings and scores relevance via fine-grained set-to-set interactions such as MaxSim (Chamfer similarity). This expressiveness improves retrieval quality over single-vector representations, but makes search substantially more expensive. Existing systems address this challenge primarily through proxy representations or filter-and-rerank pipelines that reduce candidate generation to single-vector search. We study the complementary direction of building a native IVF-style index directly over multi-vector data.   We introduce MV-IVF, an inverted-file index for multi-vector retrieval built on MV-Lloyd, a new Lloyd-style algorithm for clustering point clouds under a Chamfer objective. translated_title: MV-IVF：通过多向量聚类实现的多向量检索
translated_abstract: 多向量检索将每个查询和文档表示为一组嵌入向量，并通过细粒度的集合到集合交互（如 MaxSim，即 Chamfer 相似度）来评分相关性。这种表达能力相较于单向量表示提升了检索质量，但也使搜索成本大幅增加。现有系统主要通过代理表示或“过滤-重排”流水线来应对这一挑战，将候选生成简化为单向量搜索。我们研究了与之互补的方向：直接在多向量数据上构建原生的 IVF 风格索引。我们提出了 MV-IVF，一种面向多向量检索的倒排文件索引，它建立在 MV-Lloyd 之上——一种新的 Lloyd 风格算法，用于在 Chamfer 目标下对点云进行聚类。我们的关键观察是：一旦点云被分配到簇中，中心更新步骤就简化为对每个簇内展平的嵌入向量进行标准的单向量聚类。
tldr: 本文提出 MV-IVF，一种直接在多向量数据上构建的原生倒排文件索引，其核心是基于新的 Lloyd 风格算法 MV-Lloyd 在 Chamfer 目标下对点云聚类，从而以原生方式高效加速多向量检索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MV-IVF, a native inverted-file index built directly over multi-vector data, which leverages MV-Lloyd, a new Lloyd-style algorithm for clustering point clouds under a Chamfer objective, to efficiently accelerate multi-vector retrieval.
